arrival.one: WELCOME: Drag to walk. Tap ACTION beside the tractor to enter; EXIT returns on foot. Reach the animal-care sign to check hay.
arrival.two: WELCOME: Follow the blue marker. Tap ACTION near equipment; later you will inspect machines and hold gates.

dispatch.one: STORE REPORT: Barley is dry and ready.
dispatch.two: BUYER: Bring two loads of barley. If barley is spoiled, reserve apples are accepted instead. Inspect at dispatch, pack the safe goods, then hold ACTION together by the van.

planning_gate.one: TEAM CHOICE: Hold ACTION for three seconds at animal care for rain covers, or repair bay for maintenance. Each costs £20. Wait to save your money.
planning_gate.two: TEAM CHOICE: Covers halve apple-covering time; maintenance halves fitting time. Meet at the same place and both hold for three seconds.

planning_machine.one: STORE REPORT: Rain spoiled the barley. Two salvage apple loads remain. Read your partner's buyer clue, then ACTION at packing when ready.
planning_machine.two: BUYER: Two loads of apples. Collect at orchard apiary, pack at the canopy, then meet at the van. ACTION at dispatch when ready.

repair.one: STORES: Feed-store supplies contain a belt. Workshop parts crate contains a gasket. Ask the mechanic which part is needed. ACTION collects it; ACTION at repair bay delivers it.
repair.two: DIAGNOSIS: The packing drive slips and needs a BELT. Inspect the repair bay, then hold ACTION there while your partner delivers and helps fit it.

results.one: Weekend complete. See the TV results. Choose Play another weekend on the host or press R.
results.two: Weekend complete. See the TV results. Choose Play another weekend on the host or press R.

sheep.one: FLOCK: Guide five sheep toward the pasture gate. Approach from below to push them north. Ask your partner to refresh the eight-second latch window; deadline 2:40.
sheep.two: GATE: ACTION at the marked gate opens the latch for eight seconds. Help guide the flock while it is open, then return to refresh it. Holding ACTION also keeps it open.

weather.one: FORECAST · BEAT THE RAIN: Enter the tractor and cultivate all 16 gold plot markers. Worked plots change colour behind you. Ask your partner about storage readiness.
weather.two: STORAGE JOBS: Seal intake: hold ACTION 4s. Cover at apiary: hold ACTION 6s. Prepare packing crates: hold ACTION 4s, then help store the harvest.
